issues.description: The exercise text and class names refer to a 'Seal Saloon' (problem title and content), but both repositories' settings.gradle files name the project 'Panic-at-Burger-House' (template) and 'Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution' (solution). This divergent project naming for the same exercise concept can create minor confusion for students when locating or referencing the correct project and may give the impression the template is for a different exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the rootProject.name in both settings.gradle files to match the exercise (e.g., 'H02E02---Panic-at-Seal-Saloon' or similar consistent identifier). Keeping the project name aligned with the problem statement helps students quickly confirm they are working on the correct exercise.
